bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to detect and recognize characters' decision/judgment biases, social-attribution biases, belief-maintenance biases, memory biases, and statistical-intuition biases through shared-context multiple-choice, judgment, and open-ended questions.

bias_targets.target: Social and Implicit bias (Stereotypes, Prejudice, and Discrimination)
bias_targets.methodology: Testing the model's capacity to differentiate between cognitive stereotypes, affective prejudice, and behavioral discrimination in social scenarios using structured question-answering grounded in psychological frameworks like the Stereotype Content Model.
